comments.author: @CoreyGary
comments.text: I buy Red Bull to support athletes like Jessica Fox (Slalom Canoe), Molly Carlson (Cliff Diving), Mikaela Shiffrin (Skiing), and Carissa Moore (Surfing). They all compete in niche sports and without RB they would have a harder time  getting the exposure (or income) required to compete at the highest level. Red Bull puts these athletes on a pedestal while major sports media outlets (ESPN, Sky Sports, etc) could do a much better job at promoting them. RB is more expensive than the other brands, but it’s a private company not owned by Coke or Pepsi. So, your dollar goes to paying niche athletes who inspire future action sports stars. I prefer that over paying shareholders. I acknowledge Red Bull is more expensive than competitors, but I like the taste and to me I feel like in giving back to the action sports community.
